panel.run.help: Live state, agents, guards, findings, and cycle history for this project.

panel.memory.help: Search the decisions and lessons MjLoop retained for later runs.
panel.config.title: Project configuration
panel.config.help: Inspect the policy, verification commands, tracks, and specialist behavior MjLoop uses.
panel.features.title: Feature briefs
panel.features.help: What each feature is for, what was decided about it, and the approval a plan is built from.
panel.skills.title: Skills and routing
panel.skills.help: The component map runs are routed by, this machine's skill library, and what this project has accepted of it.
features.empty: No feature has been raised yet. /mjloop:plan can interview one into a brief.
features.record.draft: {id}, revision {revision} — a draft. Approving it fixes these words permanently.
features.record.approved: {id}, revision {revision} — approved. This revision can never be changed again.
features.record.superseded: {id}, revision {revision} — superseded by a later revision.
features.acceptanceEmpty: None recorded yet. The interview is what writes these.
features.unanswered: Still open — the interview has not answered this.
features.needsAcceptance: This draft has no acceptance criteria, and an approved brief must have at least one. The interview writes them — /mjloop:plan, not this page.
features.confirmExplain: An approved revision is permanent: it can never be edited, and it cannot be un-approved. Later plans are built from it.
skills.acceptancesWhy: What this project has accepted, and which components and agents each one reaches. Accepting, disabling and removing are commands: mjloop-cli skills accept | disable | enable | remove.
skills.acceptancesNone: This project has accepted no skill, so nothing is routed by one.
skills.libraryWhy: Every package imported on this machine, shared by every project on it. Importing is a command: mjloop-cli skills import.
skills.libraryNone: No package has been imported on this machine.
skills.packageMissing: This project accepted package {digest}, and no library on this machine holds it. Import it before a run can use it.
manifest.title: Skills pinned to this run
manifest.empty: This manifest routes no component — nothing was selected for this run.
run.uninitialised: No loop in this project — run /mjloop:init to set it up.
run.idle: Idle — nothing running. Queue a story or type a command below.
preflight.title: Before you start
preflight.why: What this track can cost at most, and what comparable runs actually took. No figure in money: the engine cannot see what an agent runs on, so a price here would be a guess wearing an estimate's clothes.
preflight.noBasis: No comparable run yet, so the numbers above rest on the track's shape alone.
plans.empty: No plans yet. Start one with /mjloop:plan.
plans.progressHint: This plan's own stories — the same numbers as the tally and the ready count, not a separate count.
plans.decisionHint: The decision on record right now, not a history — deciding again replaces it.
plans.noDecision: Nobody has decided on this plan yet.
plans.evidence.title: Evidence
plans.evidence.hint: Runs whose directory names one of this plan's own stories — a convention read from the run's folder name, not a stored link. A run started without a story cannot be matched to any plan.
plans.evidence.empty: No runs recorded against this plan's stories yet.
plans.memory.title: Memory
plans.memory.hint: Memory scoped to this plan or one of its stories when it was recorded — not guessed from a mention in its title or body.
plans.memory.empty: Nothing recorded is scoped to this plan or its stories — only memories recorded from here on can be.
plans.newPlanHint: An idea to turn into a plan
story.noPlan: No plan open. Choose one under Plans.
story.planEmpty: This plan has no stories yet.
story.command.label: Command
story.open.clear: Nothing is holding this story up.
story.deps.title: Dependency graph
story.notBuildable.doing: Already being built. Requeue it if the run was cancelled.
story.notBuildable.blocked: Blocked — the last run could not finish it.
story.noEvidence: Marked done with no evidence directory.
story.runs.title: Execution history
story.runs.empty: No runs recorded for this story yet.
evidence.handoff: handoff.md — what this cycle handed the next one
evidence.handoffCut: Cut to fit — read the file for the rest.
evidence.verify.title: What the engine verified
evidence.verify.queued: queued — another command held the lock
config.editorHelp: Changes are validated as one configuration and apply to the next run. Existing runs keep the policy they started with.
config.failurePatternsHelp: One regular expression per line. Invalid expressions fall back to the engine defaults at verification time.
config.editorUnavailable: This project has no editable config.yaml yet.
config.editorInvalid: config.yaml is invalid. The safe editor is disabled; inspect the original document below.
config.editorChanged: config.yaml changed elsewhere while you were editing. Reset to load the latest values before saving.
config.patternsTestLabel: Test failure patterns, one per line
config.patternsLintLabel: Lint failure patterns, one per line
config.patternsBuildLabel: Build failure patterns, one per line
config.specialistsHelp: A rule pins an agent in place: always means every cycle runs it, never means the leader may not draft it at all. An agent with no rule here is the leader's call.
config.specialistsEmpty: No rules — the leader composes every cycle on its own.
config.tracksHelp: What each track runs, and the ceiling it runs under. Changes apply to the next run; a run in flight keeps the policy it started with.
config.trackNewWarning: A track may name any agent, but only an agent with a definition behind it can actually be dispatched — scaffold one with /mjloop:add agent.
config.problem.noRequired: A track needs at least one required agent.
config.problem.gateUnknown: {agent} proves this gate but the track never runs it — the gate would shut the track permanently.
config.problem.blockUnknown: {agent} is blocked but the track never runs it — blocking it has no effect.
config.problem.gateSelfBlock: {agent} proves this gate and cannot also be blocked by it — the result that would open it could never be logged.
config.problem.noBlocks: A gate that blocks nothing has no effect. Name at least one agent, or turn the gate off.
config.problem.mapUnknown: {agent} drafts the map but is not draftable in a working cycle — a map nobody writes, and silently.
config.problem.forbidden: {agent} is pinned by this track but its specialist rule is never — every roster would be rejected.
config.problem.autoPlanOff: A completion of auto-plan needs discovery switched on: it names a start driven by an approved brief, and a project with discovery off never produces one.
config.problem.registryUntrusted: The registry source needs at least one trusted registry — a source that names no registry admits nothing.
config.problem.registryNotHttps: Every trusted registry must be an https:// URL — the server refuses the whole save otherwise, and this one would take the other settings in it down too.
config.editorStructuredInvalid: Tracks and specialist policy must be valid JSON objects — nothing was sent.
config.verifyWhy: Each is injected verbatim into every agent brief. A missing one is a blocked the engine may not invent around.
config.verifyPolicyWhy: The engine executes the commands above under these limits. A run pins the whole block when it starts, so an edit here takes effect at the next run.
config.orchestrationWhy: How much of a feature the loop works out on its own, and how much it asks about. Discovery is off by default: turning it on changes what /mjloop:plan does in this project.
config.trustedRegistriesHelp: One https:// URL per line. A registry named here is a place this project will fetch executable instructions from, so plain http is refused. Naming the registry source without trusting a registry is refused too — it would admit nothing.
config.profileWhy: What this project is made of, as accepted. Every later run routes on it. Accepting a map is a command — this page only reads it.
config.profileNone: No component map has been accepted, so no run is routed by one. Run /mjloop:init to scan this project.
config.profileDrift: A newer scan of this project proposes a different component map ({at}). Accepting it is a command; this page never does.
telemetry.title: Specialists, as drafted
telemetry.why: What every specialist this project drafted actually returned. A report and never a rule — nothing in the engine drafts or skips an agent because of a number here. It refreshes when the next run opens.
telemetry.empty: No runs yet, so there is nothing to report about any agent.
telemetry.flagged.one: Drafted repeatedly with no high or medium finding to show for it: {agents}
telemetry.flagged.other: Drafted repeatedly with no high or medium finding to show for them: {agents}
queue.blockedBanner: Queue stopped after a failure. Look at the transcript, then resume.
queue.pausedStopped: Queue paused because you stopped a job. Anything waiting starts again when you resume.
job.failed.exit: The session exited with code {code} before the run finished.
job.failed.early: The session closed before the run finished.
job.abandoned: Gave up waiting for “{job}” to close and moved on.
queue.blocked: “{job}” failed, so the rest of the queue is holding.
queue.failed: “{job}” failed. Read the transcript before running it again.
terminal.title: Session
terminal.idle: Nothing running. Queue a story or type a command below.
terminal.viewing: Reading a finished job — typing goes nowhere.
pane.toggle: Collapse or expand the session pane
session.stalled: The session has been quiet since {time}. It may be waiting on you.
session.stalledHint: Set autonomous: true in .mjloop/config.yaml to let cycles run on without this.
halt.title: Halt this run
halt.explain: This writes HALT.md and ends the run. Stop only closes the session and leaves the run open.
error.unreadable: Could not read that — see the terminal the server was started from.
roster.cycle: That composition is for a different cycle than the one running now.
roster.required: “{agent}” is required by the {track} track and cannot be dropped.
roster.forced: “{agent}” always runs by project settings and cannot be dropped.
roster.forbidden: “{agent}” never runs by project settings and cannot be drafted.
roster.closing: “{agent}” closes the {track} track after the run passes — it cannot be drafted into a working cycle.
roster.unknown: “{agent}” is not part of the {track} track.
roster.contradiction: “{agent}” is both drafted and skipped — pick one.
roster.unexplained: “{agent}” was left out with no reason given.
write.stale.plan: That plan was decided on somewhere else in the meantime — nothing was changed.
write.stale.story: That story moved on in the meantime — nothing was changed.
write.stale.run: A different run is active now — nothing was changed.
write.stale.feature: That feature brief was decided on somewhere else in the meantime — nothing was changed.
write.stale.config: The project settings changed in the meantime. Review the latest values and save again.
write.invalid.config: Those settings would make the project configuration invalid — nothing was changed.
write.failed: That could not be written — see the terminal the server was started from.
write.ok.halt: Run halted. HALT.md is in the run directory.
notice.title: Notifications
notice.hint: What happened this session — write results, queue notices, and status changes, in the order they were seen. Not saved: this list starts empty every time the page loads.
notice.plan.done: {id} is complete — every story is done.
notice.config.missing: Project settings became unreadable. See the banner above.
